description: a second blend that meets the first at a vertex: the extruded 2-square's side edge 0–1 (the rise at (2, 0)) filleted at r 0.3, then the cap edge of side face 0 (y = 0, z = 2), which now ends where the first blend's contact line and end arc meet — the contact is a tangent edge, so the cap edge's vertex there is a tangent vertex and the fillet runs on through the first blend's end arc into the cap edge of side face 1 (x = 2), an open chain of line, arc, line that Open CASCADE follows and blends; Arris builds it as three stripes, a cylinder, a torus section of major radius r − r2 and minor r2 and a cylinder, meeting on the ball's great circles at the two junctions (ADR-0035). The first radius is three times the second so the torus is a ring torus; at twice it the torus is a horn torus, regression/tangent-chain-horn-torus
